title: AIR Public-Surface Copywriting Method Pack v2
description: Optional reusable procedure for public-surface copy creation and review. It is selected only when the active task benefits from repeatable sequencing; ordinary copywriting judgment remains available through the Specialist without requiring this Method Pack.
purpose: Provide a low-variance, evidence-aware sequence for source-bounded public copy drafting, rewriting, cross-surface review, and copy-readiness assessment without hardcoding a particular product, brand, page set, or publication workflow.
use_when: multiple public surfaces must be drafted/reviewed consistently
a repeatable review sequence materially reduces drift or rework
claim mapping and source reconciliation are material
a release or publication workflow explicitly requires a copy review contribution
the user or artifact requests a structured copy-review method
do_not_use_when: a single trivial wording edit does not benefit from method ceremony
the actual blocker is unresolved domain truth rather than copy procedure
the active artifact selects a different method
using the method would add process without material quality or evidence benefit
required_inputs: bound Orbit 0 task and completion envelope
current public surface or requested deliverable
target readiness or release posture when material
conditional_inputs: validated task-relevant Domain Package or authoritative external source

method_steps.purpose: Establish what the active task is trying to accomplish and what the public surface must do.
operations: read bound task center, active step, completion envelope and acceptance criteria
identify audience/reader basis and surface job from current sources
surface material ambiguity rather than inventing positioning
evidence_to_advance: task and surface job are sufficiently resolved

method_steps.purpose: Separate authoritative subject truth from wording choices.
operations: load current product/subject source truth
classify material claims and evidence state
identify brand/voice source when material
identify stale/missing/conflicting source basis
evidence_to_advance: material facts and claim boundaries are known or explicitly unresolved

method_steps.purpose: Prevent copywriting from substituting for specialist domain judgment.
operations: detect legal, accessibility, technical, scientific, security, regulated, search-platform or other adjacent domain needs
request or recommend the smallest validated domain/source route when material
record limitations when an adjacent review is not required for the current step
evidence_to_advance: adjacent domain requirements are satisfied, deferred with justification, or blocking

method_steps.purpose: Build an information hierarchy that serves the reader and current surface job.
operations: prioritize reader value or task before internal mechanism names unless task context reverses that order
place necessary technical detail at the depth required by the audience
preserve required qualifications and scope boundaries
generate materially different structure/positioning candidates when the decision is consequential
evidence_to_advance: at least one candidate satisfies hard task constraints

method_steps.purpose: Produce source-bounded copy without semantic or claim drift.
operations: draft or rewrite within current scope
preserve authoritative meaning, approved terminology, and brand source
avoid invented evidence or persuasion upgrades
keep claims proportional to evidence
evidence_to_advance: candidate copy is complete for the scoped operation

method_steps.purpose: Contribute to bounded step-optimal selection when material.
operations: compare feasible candidates against active benchmark dimensions
reject candidates that fail hard requirements
prefer a candidate only when no identified feasible alternative materially dominates it after proportionate comparison
stop search when further alternatives are unlikely to materially change selection
evidence_to_advance: candidate_contribution_state is PASS_CANDIDATE, further_search_justified is false, proportional_stopping_basis_recorded is true, and material_unresolved_domination is false

method_steps.purpose: Review clarity, claim integrity, semantic fidelity, source use, audience fit, and relevant cross-surface consistency.
operations: check claim language against source/evidence state
check semantic fidelity to task/source truth
check page/surface job and audience fit
check brand/voice only against current brand sources
check jargon/technical-depth fit
check cross-surface contradictions only when scope includes them
identify adjacent-domain review needs without claiming certification
evidence_to_advance: material findings are localized and actionable

method_steps.purpose: Return the copy or review contribution without assuming completion/publication authority.
operations: emit candidate copy or localized findings
state source basis and unresolved items
state limitations and revalidation triggers
when active artifact requests readiness review, emit PASS_CONTRIBUTION/REVISE/REVIEW_REQUIRED/EVIDENCE_REQUIRED/REJECT_CONTRIBUTION/RESCOPE_REQUIRED
evidence_to_advance: Core/bound artifact has sufficient contribution state for its next decision

completion_rule: Method completion means the selected procedure produced its required candidate copy/review contribution with source, limitation, and unresolved-state visibility. It is not task completion, AMRS completion, publication approval, or material-action authorization.

knowledge_to_execution_path_contract.rule: The Method must not reduce copy work to stylistic lookup-and-execute. It must preserve source acquisition/classification, comprehension, applicability, alternative/failure analysis when material, judgment/proportionality, adaptation/planning, execution, and result evaluation required by the active benchmark.
knowledge_to_execution_path_contract.step_optimality: CW06 contributes comparative evidence only; Core owns final step-optimality and AMRS completion gates.

authority_boundary.selection_rule: Select independently when the task needs repeatable procedure; package presence does not make it active.

handoff_contract.new_task_boundary: Do not restore prior task-operative method state without applicability revalidation against the new task artifact.

review_triggers: Core NEW_TASK_BOUNDARY or Orbit 0 task identity changes
bound acceptance criteria or completion envelope changes materially
a required source, dependency, permission, or evidence basis changes materially
staleness_policy.behavior: Suspend affected method steps, revalidate the changed dependency, and invalidate downstream method evidence that depended on stale state.
